patterns: APPSC asks the cycle-type identification directly (nitrogen = cycle whose main reservoir is not soil) and the decomposer-removal consequence.
APPSC recruitment tests ask 'functions of the environment' (biodegradation function, assimilating waste not 'wealth', renewable AND non-renewable) - often as match-the-description items.
Other PSCs hammer biofertilisers: BGA/Azolla-Anabaena for paddy, Rhizobium japonicum for soybean, leg-haemoglobin in nodules, VAM for phosphorus.
Succession PYQs: lichens as pioneers on bare rock (algae+fungi), grasslands limited by water and fire, Clements monoclimax.
App over-supplies long match/multi-statement biofertiliser items and adds Clements phase details, TEEB, Costanza; APPSC depth is single-fact.
